metadata.signInDescription: Sign in to Phaseo to access the Gateway, manage teams, monitor usage, and continue with provider routing, model analytics, and account-level billing controls.
metadata.signUpDescription: Create a Phaseo account to access the Gateway, configure model routing, review performance analytics, and manage billing across personal and team workspaces.

signIn.heading: Welcome back
signIn.description: Sign in to your Phaseo account
signIn.signupNotice: If an account exists for that email, check your inbox for next steps.
signIn.invalidCredentials: Invalid email or password. Please try again.
signIn.passkeyUnavailable: Passkeys are not enabled for this environment yet.

signUp.heading: Welcome to Phaseo
signUp.invalidPassword: Password must include lowercase, uppercase, a number, and a symbol.

forgotPassword.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address
forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.successDescription: If an account exists for {email}, you'll receive a password reset link shortly.
forgotPassword.expiryHelp: Check your spam folder or try again in a few minutes. The link expires in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.

error.heading: Authentication failed
error.default: We could not complete the sign-in flow. Please try again.
error.expiredLink: Your sign-in link has expired. Please try signing in again.
error.ssoNotConfigured: Enterprise SSO is not configured for your organisation yet.
error.ssoDisabled: Enterprise SSO is configured but currently disabled.
error.ssoManaged: This account is managed by SSO. Please use Enterprise SSO to sign in.
error.cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled or denied. Please try again.
error.workspaceSetup: Your account was authenticated, but we could not finish setting up your workspace. Please contact support.
